decision: The 384-token training cap fails the predeclared short-run quality gate: held-out correct-answer changes are +3/245 and -7/493 versus the 192-token control; execution failures change by +3. Public scores are 570/960 versus 573/960. The previous best remains 575/960. Do not combine this change on the basis of this short trial. Retaining complete original targets remains a data-integrity requirement to address, and a short negative continuation does not rule out a longer-run benefit. No long run started.
compute: The driver took 296.55 seconds (4.94 minutes), including restoration, both training arms and evaluation. Training process times were 98.28 and 116.56 seconds. Steady logged throughput was 1567.3 versus 1270.1 examples/s. Whole-driver GPU utilization averaged 65.69% (median 96%); peak memory was 46411 MiB. Allocation, Drive sign-in and installation are outside this driver timing.
next: Handle rare long original sequences without silently training on incomplete programs.
